Quick notes and attachments from CI/CD side. I pulled a sanitized CI pipeline run and the ephemeral runner attestations. See attached ephemeral-runner-attestation-20260815.txt and ci-pipeline-snapshot-20260815.txt.

Key points to call out in the bundle:
- Ephemeral runners: we use ephemeral GitHub Actions runners for customer-facing jobs in the prod pool; each runner lifecycle is < 10 minutes and is terminated automatically after the job. The attestation file shows start/end timestamps and terminated instance ids (redacted).
- Secrets: service tokens are stored in HashiCorp Vault; access is role-bound via our Vault policies and all access is forwarded to KMS for key operations. The KMS rotation summary (Marissa) shows the last 6 rotations; rotation is automated quarterly.
- CI attestations: pipeline snapshot includes the PR number, short job logs (sanitized), and the step timestamps that show the successful signature and deploy-staging pass.

Let me know if we should include a short verification note about our ephemeral runner image build provenance. I can generate a signed manifest if Greenline requests cryptographic provenance.
